title: Introduction of a visual preparation tool for the outpatient clinic in the Department of Pediatric Pneumology at Hannover Medical School
summary: Fear of visiting the doctor is a common phenomenon that can be particularly problematic for children with chronic illnesses, as they face regular doctor’s visits.  With this in mind, we have created a picture book in which Froggie, the stuffed frog, introduces our outpatient clinic and explains the various examinations. We now want to investigate whether reading the picture book helps the CF children in our outpatient clinic feel less anxious and be more receptive to the examinations. In addition to the children, we also want to find out whether the parents’ anxiety, as well as the overall family stress, changes as a result of using the book.
conditions: Fear of doctors in children with cystic fibrosis
